definitions.explanation: Not making the best use of time, resources, or effort; failing to achieve maximum output with minimum waste.

examples.japanese: {非効率的|ひこうりつてき}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非効率的|ひこうりつてき}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this approach is inefficient.

examples.japanese: {非効率的|ひこうりつてき}な⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧になっている。
examples.english: Too many inefficient meetings are a source of employee frustration.

notes:
The negative counterpart of ⟦{効率的|こうりつてき}→効率的：06240_kouritsuteki⟧ (efficient), formed by adding the prefix ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-; un-). Commonly used in business and organizational contexts to criticize processes, systems, or methods that waste time and resources.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非効率的|ひこうりつてき}な⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧: inefficient operations
- {非効率的|ひこうりつてき}な⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: inefficient use
- {非効率的|ひこうりつてき}な⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧: inefficient organization
- {非効率的|ひこうりつてき}な⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧: inefficient management

THE PREFIX {非|ひ}:
The prefix ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ negates the meaning of a word, similar to English "un-" or "non-":
- ⟦{非公式|ひこうしき}→非公式：20590_hikoushiki⟧: unofficial
- ⟦{非常識|ひじょうしき}→非常識：14615_hijoushiki⟧: lacking common sense
- {非現実的|ひげんじつてき}: unrealistic
- ⟦{非合理的|ひごうりてき}→非合理的：23816_higouriteki⟧: irrational

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: inefficient — a more colloquial way to express the same idea
- ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: wasteful — focuses on the waste produced rather than the inefficiency of the process
- {非生産的|ひせいさんてき}: unproductive — emphasizes lack of output rather than poor use of resources
